checks.text: The page heading is "Voice Recorder" and the text "No clips yet" is visible.
Clicking the button "Record" changes the button label to "Stop" and starts an elapsed timer that displays "00:00" initially.

After clicking "Stop", the elapsed timer stops and a new list item appears containing the text "Clip 1" and a duration in the format "00:0X" where X is the number of seconds recorded (at least 1 second). The text "No clips yet" is no longer visible.
Clicking the button "Download" on the list item for "Clip 1" triggers a file download with the filename "Clip 1.wav".
Clicking the button "Delete" on the list item for "Clip 1" removes that item from the list. If no other clips exist, the text "No clips yet" reappears.
After recording a second clip, the list shows two items: "Clip 1" and "Clip 2", each with their respective durations.

Clicking the tab "Settings" shows a select labelled "Format" with options "WAV" and "MP3". Selecting "MP3" and then recording a new clip results in a list item "Clip 3" with a duration, and clicking "Download" on it triggers a file download with the filename "Clip 3.mp3".
After recording "Clip 1" and "Clip 2", reloading the page still shows both list items with the exact text "Clip 1" and "Clip 2" and their original durations.
